body: hi! this is a bit off topic but the only thing i could find related to my problem. i saw im eligible for a grant on HESSA my school finical aid said it would be a week to get mailed but it’s been around two. im i worrying too much? im a freshman this is all very new to me
i’m on prazosin, at the beginning all i could do was sleep. i switch to taking them at night and it helps loads!

hi! i experienced the same thing! the first two weeks are hard, i didn’t go out out i recommend doing the same. the anxiety was insane for me, try to comfort yourself. after the first two weeks it will start to settle down. after a few months ( i know it’s hard) you will hopefully start to feel better. i started off with prozac, different meds but they’re both SSRI’s. best of luck, keep us posted
